Movement and Manoeuvres: Moving or performing stunts on mounts requires one manoeuvre from the rider per turn, unless the horse is standing still or moving in a straight line. If the rider does not use a manoeuvre, the mount either continues in a straight line, drifts to a stop, or some action consistent with its nature (GM’s choice). The rider cannot use any movement manoeuvres while on the mount, except to dismount or direct the horse. Instead, the horse uses its own manoeuvres to move about the battlefield. Most horses are Swift, and so receive one free move manoeuvre per turn (in addition to the free manoeuvre all characters and creatures receive).
